name: Isaac Sim LabUtopia (RTX, headless)
desc: Official NVIDIA Isaac Sim 5.1.0 with LabUtopia installed from upstream at first boot
readme: Non-commercial research/education only. LABUTOPIA_ACCEPT_CC_BY_NC_4_0=Y records your acceptance of the upstream asset terms.
env: -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e PRIVACY_CONSENT=Y -e LABUTOPIA_ACCEPT_CC_BY_NC_4_0=Y -e OMNI_KIT_ALLOW_ROOT=1 -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all -e NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all -e VAST_PERSIST_ROOT=/workspace
onstart: mkdir -p /workspace/logs; python3 -c 'import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlretrieve("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/noguhiro2002/isaacsim-vastai/main/vastai/bootstrap.sh", "/tmp/vast-bootstrap.sh")'; bash /tmp/vast-bootstrap.sh labutopia 2>&1 | tee /workspace/logs/bootstrap-labutopia.log
